goal: Connect React Frontend Auto Trader with Supabase Cloud Session Bus: 24/7 Cloud State Synchronization, Realtime Subscription, Remote Session Recovery, and Cloud Status Indicator

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderSessionRow { id: string; user_id?: string; status: 'STOPPED' | 'SCANNING' | 'IN_POSITION' | 'PAUSED'; selected_capital: number; duration_minutes: number; daily_target_pct: number; daily_max_loss_pct: number; max_trades_per_day: number; trading_profile: string; digest_interval: string; active_position?: any; session_start_time?: string; session_realized_pnl_usd: number; session_realized_pnl_pct: number; closed_trades_today: number; updated_at?: string; }
function_signatures: subscribeToAutoTraderSession(userId: string, callback: (session: AutoTraderSessionRow) => void): () => void

execution_steps: Write unit test in frontend/src/__tests__/cloud_auto_trader_sync.test.js for session persistence and remote state hydration
Run node --test frontend/src/__tests__/cloud_auto_trader_sync.test.js to verify red phase
Add AutoTraderSessionRow interface and session CRUD/subscription functions to frontend/src/lib/supabase.ts
Integrate cloud session persistence and realtime sync into AutoTraderContext.tsx (startSession, pauseSession, stopSession, and mount hydration)
Expose isCloudConnected and cloudSessionState in AutoTraderContext
Update AutoTraderView.tsx to display 24/7 Cloud Worker status badge and live synchronization indicators
Run node --test frontend/src/__tests__/cloud_auto_trader_sync.test.js to verify green phase
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/lib/supabase.ts provides typed functions to fetch, upsert, and subscribe to auto_trader_sessions
When startSession() is invoked, session is upserted to Supabase with status SCANNING
When pauseSession() or stopSession() is invoked, Supabase status reflects PAUSED or STOPPED
When component mounts, active cloud session in Supabase automatically hydratates the UI
Realtime changes from the 24/7 Render worker update active_position, PnL, and trades count without page reload
All tests in cloud_auto_trader_sync.test.js pass with exit code 0
Frontend build completes without TypeScript or Vite errors
